question: Should ClawHub make duplicate-case `SKILL.md`/`skills.md`/`PROTOCOL.md` package file collisions a hard publish/import rejection now, and what docs/spec update is required before merge?
rationale: The PR fixes a real cross-platform package problem, but it changes the accepted package contract and can reject existing packages or import candidates that current docs do not forbid.

options.title: Document and prove stricter rejection
options.body: Require the package policy docs/spec plus redacted live CLI, web, API, or import proof before merging the current direction.

options.title: Accept the code-only compatibility break
options.body: Merge the stricter gate without additional policy documentation, accepting the support and upgrade ambiguity.

options.title: Narrow or pause the scope
options.body: Hold the PR if `PROTOCOL.md` handling or collision scope should be decided separately before code lands.

recommendation.title: Document and prove stricter rejection
recommendation.body: Require the package policy docs/spec plus redacted live CLI, web, API, or import proof before merging the current direction.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-history owner for the documented skill package contract and central publish/import surfaces.
